clue.text: Attempt permitted to interrupt dreadful trio in opera

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into something, so these letters go inside the scrambled trio
dreadful suggests something badly made, so the letters of trio are rearranged

parts.note: an attempt is a go
permitted means let

explanation.surface: A trio of singers so bad that someone is allowed to cut in during the opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' scrambles the trio so that its letters fall either side of the inserted pair, which 'interrupt' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Verdi's famous work about a hunchbacked court jester is an opera.

clue.text: Quick investigation regarding source of corruption in church

parts.note: re is a short word for regarding or about

indicators.note: in places the first letter of corruption within the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it begins, its first letter

explanation.surface: A rapid inquiry into where corruption in the church started.
explanation.definitionFit: A recce is informal British military slang, short for reconnaissance, a quick survey of an area.

clue.text: Old King with freedom to release fifty in acknowledgement

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George

indicators.note: releasing something lets it go, so the letter is taken out

parts.note: latitude is freedom of action
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: An old monarch with liberty to free fifty prisoners as a gesture of thanks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to release' takes L out of LATITUDE, leaving ATITUDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Gratitude is thankfulness, and acknowledgement can mean thanks expressed for something.

clue.text: Past TV series? Some not so likely to be brought up

indicators.note: in a down clue bringing letters up reads them from bottom to top
some of the words means a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: An old television show, one that some would say is unlikely to be raised in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks TSOL from 'not so likely' and 'brought up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Lost is a word for past or gone, and also the title of an American drama about plane-crash survivors.

clue.text: Hill climbing out with our squad involved

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing reads the word upwards, so out goes backwards

parts.note: our group is us

explanation.surface: A hill-walking party going out with the team.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tortuous is convoluted, full of twists, just as an involved explanation is complicated.

clue.text: Various job lots seen to incorporate constant warning

indicators.note: incorporating something takes it into the body, so the letter goes inside
various suggests a mixture, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: c is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light

explanation.surface: Assorted auction lots seen to include a persistent caution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Various' scrambles JOB LOTS SEEN, and 'to incorporate' puts C among them.
explanation.definitionFit: An object lesson is a striking example that serves as a warning to others.

clue.text: Roster of names curtailed after capturing feasible rugby team

indicators.note: capturing takes something in, so these letters go inside the shortened roster
curtailed means having its tail, the last letter, cut off

parts.note: a roster of names is a list
something feasible is on, as in 'that's not on'

explanation.surface: A squad list trimmed down once a workable rugby side has been picked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' cuts LIST to LIS, and 'capturing' holds ON. The British and Irish Lions are a touring rugby union side.
explanation.definitionFit: The British and Irish Lions are a rugby union side selected from four home nations for overseas tours.

clue.text: Large distance? Largish yet possibly achievable!

indicators.note: achievable possibly, that is, by another arrangement, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Is a fairly big gap still within reach?
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly achievable' rearranges LARGISH YET, an exact ten-letter match.
explanation.definitionFit: A light year is a unit of astronomical distance, the span light travels in a year, so plural it is a vast gap.

clue.text: Green shows shape of hole, as it happens

parts.note: a hole is round, the shape of the letter O
live broadcasting is shown as it happens

explanation.surface: A golf green displays the outline of the hole in real time.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive is a dull yellowish shade of green, so it is an example of the colour.

clue.text: Views complaints about metal grille at the opening

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the complaints go round the metal and letter

parts.note: sighs are expressions of complaint
tin is a metal

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Grumbles over a metal grating at an entrance obstructing the view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the complaints round the metal and the opening letter of grille together.
explanation.definitionFit: Sightings are glimpses or observations, so they are views of something.

clue.text: Increasingly crude exclamation about bit of crude language?

indicators.note: about means going round, so the exclamation surrounds the vulgar word

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise
arse is a rude British word for the backside

explanation.surface: A cry of surprise at some rough talk that is getting cruder.
explanation.walkthrough: COR is a British cry like 'gosh'; ARSE is British slang for bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarser is the comparative of coarse, meaning more vulgar or rough, so more crude.

clue.text: Prompting Judge to override start of recording

indicators.note: overriding the start replaces the first letter with something else

parts.note: logging is recording data

explanation.surface: A judge urging someone to overrule what is being recorded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to override start of' swaps J for the L at the front of LOGGING.
explanation.definitionFit: Jogging someone's memory is prompting it, nudging it into action.

clue.text: Sinful? Quick to pull back

indicators.note: pulling something back reverses its direction, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: quick means alive, as in 'the quick and the dead'

explanation.surface: Is it wicked to withdraw too hastily?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quick' here means living, its biblical sense, not fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil means wicked or morally wrong, a synonym of sinful.

clue.text: Trip to Concertgebouw, perhaps, requiring everyone to pay?

definitions.text: Trip to Concertgebouw, perhaps, requiring everyone to pay?

parts.words: Trip to Concertgebouw, perhaps, requiring everyone to pay
parts.note: an outing to the Amsterdam concert hall would be a Netherlands treat; a meal or outing where each person pays their own share has the same name

explanation.surface: An outing to Amsterdam's concert hall where each person covers their own ticket.
explanation.walkthrough: The Concertgebouw is Amsterdam's famous concert hall, so a trip there is a treat in the Netherlands.
explanation.definitionFit: A Dutch treat is an outing where each participant pays for themselves.

clue.text: Surgeon initially reckoning to constrain skin blemish steadily

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter
constraining holds something in, so the blemish goes inside the reckoning

parts.note: a tally is a count or reckoning
a wart is a growth on the skin

explanation.surface: A surgeon's first assessment aimed at containing a mole.
explanation.definitionFit: Stalwartly means loyally and firmly, without wavering, which is acting steadily.

clue.text: Uncertain start to derby — but foul is despicable

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter
despicable suggests something corrupted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unclear opening to a local football match, but the foul is shameful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'despicable' scrambles BUT FOUL into OUBTFUL after D.
explanation.definitionFit: Doubtful means open to doubt, not sure, which is uncertain.

clue.text: Society girl greatly wanted to embrace you finally becoming abandoned

parts.note: a deb is a debutante, a young woman entering society

indicators.note: embracing holds something in, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: ached means longed for greatly

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter

explanation.surface: A debutante longed to hug you and ended up forsaken.
explanation.walkthrough: Here 'abandoned' means unrestrained in behaviour, not deserted.
explanation.definitionFit: Abandoned can mean wild and unrestrained, without morals, the same sense as debauched.

clue.text: See 5
Meteorologist's first study blocking keeping weather indicator

indicators.note: blocking sits in the way, so these letters go inside

parts.note: keeping something is storing it, so store

indicators.note: first means take the first letter

parts.note: to con is to study

explanation.surface: A weather forecaster's first piece of research gets in the way of storage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' is read as a noun, as in goods kept in store; 'blocking' puts the forecaster's initial and the study inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A storm cone is a canvas cone hoisted at coastguard stations as a gale warning, so it indicates weather.

clue.text: Enterprise navigator upset about recent wails

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the overturned name goes round the other word
in a down clue upset turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: Sulu is the helmsman of the starship Enterprise in Star Trek
late can mean recent, as in the late developments

explanation.surface: A Star Trek crew member is distressed about recent cries.
explanation.definitionFit: To ululate is to howl or wail with a trilling sound.

clue.text: What's used to mash potatoes, other veg and half of leek?

parts.note: beet is a vegetable other than potatoes

indicators.note: half of takes the first two of four letters

explanation.surface: A kitchen query: what crushes potatoes, plus another vegetable and part of a leek?
explanation.definitionFit: A beetle is a heavy wooden mallet, traditionally also used as a potato masher.

clue.text: Government left soldiers with bills to pay? Wonderful

parts.note: OR, other ranks, are ordinary soldiers
IOUs are written promises of money owed

explanation.surface: The government abandoned its troops, leaving them with debts to settle: marvellous.
explanation.definitionFit: Glorious means magnificent or delightful, a synonym for wonderful.

clue.text: Information about Arab-Dutch plot

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the information goes round the abbreviations

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
Ar is an abbreviation for Arab or Arabic

explanation.surface: Intelligence concerning an Arab-Dutch conspiracy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plot' looks like a scheme, but it is a patch of land.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden is a plot of ground for growing plants.

clue.text: Easily the best for those hating percussion?

definitions.meaning: impossible to defeat, far ahead of others
read as ..., unable to stand drum beats

explanation.surface: The finest thing of all for people who loathe drums.
explanation.definitionFit: Unbeatable means impossible to surpass, and split up jokily it means unable to bear beats.

clue.text: Outspoken but interrupted by Liberal then Nationalist

indicators.note: then means a second break-in follows the first, further along the word
something interrupted has letters break into it

explanation.surface: A frank speaker keeps getting cut off by Liberal and Nationalist politicians.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes into BUT to give BLUT, and 'then' puts N in as well.
explanation.definitionFit: A blunt person is frank and direct, saying exactly what they think.

clue.text: In the thick of receiving millions in support

indicators.note: receiving takes something in, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: aid is support or help

explanation.surface: At the centre of a funding drive that brings in millions in backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Amid is a preposition meaning surrounded by, in the middle of things.

clue.text: Unappealing poster showing nymph

parts.note: dry can mean dull or uninteresting
a poster is an advertisement, an ad

explanation.surface: A dull advertisement featuring a mythical maiden.
explanation.definitionFit: A dryad is a tree nymph in Greek mythology.

clue.text: Meat from US picnic (no cake around)

indicators.note: no means without, so these letters are removed
around shows the removed letters sit on either side of what is left

parts.note: a clambake is an American seaside party where clams are cooked
the word cake taken as written

explanation.surface: A meat course at an American outdoor feast, with no dessert to go round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no' with 'around' removes C at the front and AKE at the back of CLAMBAKE.
explanation.definitionFit: Lamb is the meat of a young sheep.

clue.text: Disliked accommodating a Parisian affected by the past

indicators.note: accommodating gives room to something, so the letters go inside

parts.note: hated means strongly disliked
un is French for a, as a Parisian would say

explanation.surface: An unpopular person who took in a Frenchman is troubled by history.
explanation.definitionFit: Being haunted means troubled by memories of earlier events, or visited by ghosts of former times.

clue.text: Variety of coat? Yes

indicators.note: a variety of something is another form of it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A question and answer: is this a kind of coat? Yes.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue also defines the answer: a padded cover for a teapot is a kind of coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea cosy is an insulating cover put over a teapot, a coat of sorts for it.

clue.text: Tense time in self-produced song

indicators.note: in places these letters within the other word

parts.note: DIY, do-it-yourself, describes things you produce yourself
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: A nervy moment while recording a home-made tune.
explanation.definitionFit: A ditty is a short simple song.

clue.text: Delivery of claret following punch?

parts.note: claret is boxing slang for blood, so blood flowing after a blow to the face

explanation.surface: Wine being served after a bowl of mixed drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'claret' and 'punch' look like drinks; in boxing slang claret is blood and the punch is a blow.
explanation.definitionFit: A nosebleed is a flow of blood from the nose, common after a blow to the face.
